title: StaleStateRecord
description: Records stale-state and validity-interval metadata for a SourceOS local object, distinguishing observed time, event time, and valid time, and linking to any repair plan.

id.description: URN of this stale-state record. Format: urn:srcos:stale-state:<slug>

objectRef.description: URN of the object whose state is stale.

stalenessClass.description: Why this object is considered stale.

observedAt.description: When the staleness was observed (observed time).

eventTime.description: When the underlying event that caused staleness occurred.

validFrom.description: Start of the validity interval for the recorded state.

validUntil.description: End of the validity interval. Null means indefinite.

conflictRecord.description: Local-first contradiction record when two sources disagree.

repairPlanRef.description: URN of the repair plan that addresses this stale-state record.

autoRepairEligible.description: Whether the stale state can be repaired without human review.

evidenceRefs.description: URNs of evidence artifacts that detected or described the staleness.
